correctness.rationale: Identity F=A²(u-v)²-2AB(s(u+v)+u²+v²)+B²(s+u+v)² is symbolic-exact. Det Q=-4A²B²(A-B)² confines singularities to three coefficient walls. Three chain-rule reductions give precise necessary-and-sufficient singular conditions; A=B=0 contributes four threefolds. All 16 irreducible components are obtained and generic quadratic transverse Hessian ranks are nondegenerate. Each threefold is a codimension-one singular locus in the irreducible X, so R1 fails. Exact symbolic verification covers all claims of algebraic identity; it does not substitute for completeness proof.
